scoring_justification: The checker independently recomputes the thermodynamic quantities using the Miedema-Bakker model and compares the agent's computed values against these recomputed references.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference recomputed values for all target thermodynamic quantities.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Computed by the checker using the Miedema-Bakker model with elemental parameters from Miedema's work (as per paper).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Inline Python recomputation using formulas in instruction.md and reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are determined by the publicly available model and parameters, not arbitrary. The checker recomputes them on the fly, so no hidden static gold file is needed.

outputs.description: Computed thermodynamic values (Gibbs free energy, amorphous formation energy, intermetallic formation enthalpy, centrifugal-field modified free energy) for the four validation alloy systems, all in kJ/mol.

output_contract.notes: All values are in kJ/mol. Ternary systems use Hillert extrapolation. Centrifugal field parameters: radius=150 mm, angular velocity=6000 rpm (~628 rad/s), duration 4 h.

steps.note: All values are compared against recomputed references. The checker's recompute uses identical formulas as the reference solve.sh.
